.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.name: SVG contrast check (.agents)

.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.name: Excalidraw bridge (.agents)
.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.description: Converts brand SVG rect, text and line diagrams to deterministic Excalidraw scenes and back; the .agents copy.

.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.name: Round arrow elbows (.agents)
.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.description: Rewrites the elbows of straight marker-end arrow paths in an SVG into quadratic curves with round joins, in place; the .agents copy.

.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.name: Skill tool security tests (.agents)
.agents/skills/arbitrum-brand-svg-diagra.description: Unit-tests the bridge, contrast and build.py helpers for colour injection and path escapes using private temp fixtures; the .agents copy.

.agents/skills/image-debt-scan/scan.sh.name: Image debt scan

.claude/hooks/optimize-svg.sh.name: SVG optimize hook (Claude)
.claude/hooks/optimize-svg.sh.description: PostToolUse: runs svgo with the repo config on an edited public/img SVG read from the hook's file_path; a no-op until svgo is installed.

.codex/agents/diagram-converter.toml.name: Diagram converter agent
.codex/agents/diagram-converter.toml.description: Codex agent brief for converting one raster diagram in public/img into a brand SVG and updating the MDX that references it; parallel-safe.

.codex/config.toml.name: Codex shell settings
.codex/config.toml.description: Sets the Codex shell environment: core inheritance plus bash timeout, output cap, NODE_ENV=development and the output-token limit.

.codex/environments/environment.toml.name: Codex environment
.codex/environments/environment.toml.description: Autogenerated Codex environment record naming the repo with an empty setup script; not hand-edited.

.codex/hooks/changed-paths.sh.name: Changed paths helper
.codex/hooks/changed-paths.sh.description: Prints the absolute paths a hook event touched, from tool_input.file_path or the apply_patch headers in tool_input.command.

.codex/hooks/format-changed.sh.name: Prettier on edit
.codex/hooks/format-changed.sh.description: PostToolUse: runs Prettier --write on every file the edit touched, mirroring the format:check gate; never blocks.

.codex/hooks/guard-generated-content.sh.name: Generated content guard
.codex/hooks/guard-generated-content.sh.description: PreToolUse: exits 2 on an edit to a generated page or partial and names the pnpm generator to run instead.

.codex/hooks/guard-raster-assets.py.name: Raster asset guard
.codex/hooks/guard-raster-assets.py.description: PreToolUse: blocks a Write or Edit that adds a raster under static/img or an SVG that embeds a base64 raster.

.codex/hooks/optimize-svg.sh.name: SVG optimize hook (Codex)
.codex/hooks/optimize-svg.sh.description: PostToolUse: runs svgo on every edited public/img SVG listed by changed-paths.sh; a no-op until svgo is installed.

.codex/hooks/require-pattern-guide.sh.name: Style guide gate (Codex)
.codex/hooks/require-pattern-guide.sh.description: PreToolUse: denies the session's first prose-doc write found via changed-paths.sh and returns STYLE-GUIDE.md; fails open.

.codex/hooks/run-colocated-tests.sh.name: Colocated test runner
.codex/hooks/run-colocated-tests.sh.description: PostToolUse: runs the sibling *.test.ts with node --test when a script under scripts/ changes and exits 2 on failure.

.claude/skills/arbitrum-brand-video-expl.name: Nonce retry buffer animation
.claude/skills/arbitrum-brand-video-expl.description: Example for the video-explainers skill: a Python script that writes a 15-second looping CSS-animated SVG of the sequencer nonce retry buffer expiring. Keyframe tables per chip (other senders, nonce 8, nonce 7, the error, the boot) become @keyframes rules; a second CLI argument bakes a static frame at time t for verification, and base attributes hold the end state so prefers-reduced-motion and rsvg-convert show a sensible still.
